BiblicalUsage: Slothfulness is the word for the idleness that lets a house decay, and the proverb says slothfulness casts into a deep sleep while the idle soul suffers hunger. By much slothfulness the building decays, and through idleness of the hands the house drops through.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a house falls the same way a soul does, not all at once but by small neglects, and the cure is to take up the work.
